$schema_note: Companion to docs/architecture/module-split-plan.md — the machine-readable half of that plan. HAND-MAINTAINED: read $maintenance before you edit it. This is a snapshot of src/** measured at measured_at.commit, not a live index of the current tree.

$maintenance.how: By hand. There is no generator in this repository and one is deliberately not committed: the analysis that produced this file was a one-off, and a one-off analysis script that produced a design artefact is not a gate and must not become one (commit 36dc36c0; AGENTS.md, 'Do not build platform-level tooling here').
$maintenance.why_this_note_exists: The header used to read 'Generated for docs/architecture/module-split-plan.md. Regenerate from the artifact; never hand-edit.' That named the one action nobody in-tree could take and forbade the only action available, so the rational move was to do nothing — which is the mechanism by which this file went stale. The 'generated' stamp made it worse by inviting readers to trust the file as current (#1698).
$maintenance.who: Whoever changes the module split, or whoever deletes or moves an authored src/** file that files[] names.
$maintenance.when: When an edit would otherwise leave a files[] row pointing at a path that no longer exists, or would make a statement here untrue of measured_at.commit. Not on every file added: this is evidence for one plan, not an index of the tree.
$maintenance.do_not_hand_patch: The figures — totals, ratchet, edges, modules[].files, modules[].authored_tokens and files[].authored_tokens — are one measurement taken at measured_at.commit. They are true of that commit, they cannot be re-derived by hand, and no generator exists to re-derive them. Leave them as measured and read them as history; never adjust them to look current.

$hand_edits.change: Removed the files[] row for src/flows/case-csat-followup.flow.ts (kind 'flow', module app.objectstack.hotcrm.service, 413 authored tokens). The file existed at measured_at.commit and was deleted afterwards by #1699, so the row was correct as history but was being read as a pointer to a live file.
$hand_edits.figures_left_as_measured: totals.src_files stays 171 and modules[] 'Service'.files stays 23, per do_not_hand_patch, so files[] now holds 170 rows. Putting the removed path back gives the roster exactly as measured: it was a 171/171 match with `git ls-tree -r --name-only a6be39a3 src/` restricted to *.ts and *.md.
$hand_edits.roster_drift_measured_at_this_date: Apart from that one row, files[] had no error against measured_at.commit. Against the tree at 523eb0de it is short 34 authored files added since the measurement: 32 locale sub-bundles under src/translations/{en,es-ES,ja-JP,zh-CN}/ from the #1311 bundle split (the six barrels files[] lists still exist), plus src/flows/_guarded-iteration.ts and src/flows/case-escalation-stamp.flow.ts. They are absent by design — a snapshot is not an index — and are listed here so the gap is known rather than assumed.

measured_at.meaning: The commit every figure below was measured at. It is NOT a claim that this file was generated from the current tree, and NOT a claim that files[] matches it. docs/architecture/module-split-plan.md anchors its own 'Measured against' line to this stamp, so the stamp stays — it is a measurement stamp, not a generation stamp.
measured_at.basis: dist/objectstack.json (pnpm build) for every declaration and reference; src/** for file identity; token counts from scripts/check-source-token-ratchet.mjs (its exported authoredText + tokensOf, unmodified)
measured_at.decision_record: ADR-0130 — the release artifact is the co-ownership boundary (one artifact, N packages)

first_cut_ranking.criterion: A module is cheap to lift out when nothing points INTO it (inbound lookups), it owns no hook attached to a foreign object (R4 needs real code motion, not a manifest edit), and it touches few of the item classes the four rules never measured. R1 and R2 edges are proven and carry no risk; R3 is a mechanical manifest change.
